rows.statement: Professional head coaches fired per season, 2017 to 2025, in-season and end-of-season together: 7, 8, 5, 7, 8, 5, 9, 7, 8 (range five to nine). Calibration target of E4.3.1 rule 9 and K8.4.1.

rows.statement: A professional head coach under a general manager who did not hire him had a 25% firing chance against 18% under the general manager who hired him (2017 hot-seat model). The gm_factor 1.39 of E4.3.1 rule 5 is the ratio.
